title: Apple CEO To Meet With Trump Wednesday Afternoon
text: Apple CEO To Meet With Trump Wednesday Afternoon CUPERTINO (dpa-AFX) - Apple Inc. (AAPL) chief Executive Officer Tim Cook is set to meet with the U.S. President Donald Trump on Wednesday at 1:45 p.m. ET, according to the White House daily schedule. Trump tweeted,'Looking forward to my meeting with Tim Cook of Apple. We will be talking about many things, including how the U.S. has been treated unfairly for many years, by many countries, on trade.'Copyright RTT News/dpa-AFX Der Dauerstreit mit Apple belastet weiter die Bilanz des Chipkonzerns Qualcomm. Der Gewinn fiel im vergangenen Quartal auf 400 Millionen Dollar von 700 Millionen ein Jahr zuvor.
